description: The shapes read once a CSV has been imported: the size/row/column LIMITS the client pre-flights against, one imported CSV's CATALOG (nested inside a sources listing or a SELECT), the GET /api/evidence-csv sources listing, a paginated SELECT of one committee/cycle's rows, and the bounded error-payload shape (never a leaked Python exception string). Orientation only - the examples are the contract. v3 (S7, 2026-09-17): every committee carries the category the file gave it or the FEC committee master inferred, with the source of that label; the CATALOG carries the per-category rollup the picker filters on, its excluded-row count and the CATALOG_VERSION its rules were built under, plus the three fields that say whether this console is re-reading the import; the SELECT carries the rows the workbook excluded from its own analysis. v4 (S6, 2026-09-17): every CATALOG carries the `industry` its Mentat workbook file name declares (blank for any other file), derived at listing time so an import already on disk never needs a re-read for it; and one committee's SUMMARY - source, committee, cycles, the channel totals for the requested cycle, the channel totals of every cycle, the top ten counterparties by amount over supported rows, and the supported/excluded/unsupported counts - is the shape a pane and the compare strip read instead of paging rows they do not show. v5 (console redesign build 06, 2026-09-22, board B19): in the GET /api/evidence-csv sources listing, each committee of an import that is not being re-read also carries the figure its pane leads with, for the PAC picker rail: `receipts` (the largest channel total over every cycle; null when the committee has no supported row), `receipts_channel` (that channel; blank when there is none) and `receipts_by_cycle` ({cycle: the largest channel total within that cycle}, only cycles with supported rows), read from the import's sqlite totals by Store.committee_figures. An import being re-read (state 'reading') lists its committees without them, exactly as its CATALOG does; Store.catalog, the job status and SELECT are unchanged.
